title: Gurney Journey in Eastpointe
content: Fans of Gurney Journey will be interested to know that, in the words of Detroit Free Press reporter Kim Shine, "The Gurney Journey takes place from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. Saturday.”If you go to Eastpointe, Michigan's Art and Ice Festival next Saturday and Sunday be sure to check out the gurney races. These events “have team members pushing one another on wheeled stretchers. The event is open to any four-person team that wants to race through an obstacle course for a $40 donation per team."Link.
